lines: Round 20 judged summer and it did not pass: 5, 4 and 4 of 10 from three critics, 3 of 15 from the jury against 8 of 10 for the approved images, one critic still out. Five builders start on its faults next.
The 4K masters can be drawn by two kinds of machine that now print the same bytes. A fault found in the live app (the flakes stand still after a slow frame) is being mended.
phase 6: 7.01 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (after the review): 7.01 h used of 12.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: Summer at rest: the approved image on the left, the build Round 20 judged on the right (final tier, cropped alike). Ours is darker inside, on a greyer base, with a wider apron of sand
Summer in the shake: the approved image on the left, ours on the right. The critic's words for ours: a transparent cage of long straight hairlines
